title: Popover
api:
interface PopoverProps {
  trigger: ReactElement
  title?: string
  description?: string
  children: ReactNode
  open?: boolean
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  side?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BasePopover.Positioner>['side']
  align?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BasePopover.Positioner>['align']
  sideOffset?: number
  className?: string
  /** Override focus when opened; omitted values retain Base UI's touch-safe default. */
  initialFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BasePopover.Popup>['initialFocus']
  /** Override the return target when the trigger is removed or the workflow moves elsewhere. */
  finalFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BasePopover.Popup>['finalFocus']
  'aria-label'?: string
}

function Popover({
  trigger,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  open,
  defaultOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  side = 'bottom',
  align = 'start',
  sideOffset = 8,
  className,
  initialFocus,
  finalFocus,
  'aria-label': ariaLabelProp,
}: PopoverProps);

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Override focus when opened; omitted values retain Base UI's touch-safe default.

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: Override the return target when the trigger is removed or the workflow moves elsewhere.

notes: Use Popover for anchored supporting content. Keep its trigger focusable and give the popup a title or aria-label.
Positioning and portals are owned by Moru; do not move the popup outside the theme provider manually.
